'''Steve Baroni''' is a core member of [[Kashyyyk Train of Dominance]]. He played the [[2022 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-swccg-world-championship/ 2022 World Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
